summary: Father and two boys (12 and 14) from New Mexico reported missing on the Warner Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP, after the boys got separated from their father on a short hike and the father did not promptly return; park rangers searched the upper route and rim, then hiked overnight gear to the canyon bottom; the man and boys were found around midnight at the Gunnison River, hungry and thirsty but in good condition, and hiked out with rangers Wednesday morning
location: Warner Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP rangers
notes: NPS morning report dated 2014-08-07; reported missing afternoon Tuesday 2014-08-05
